Jwt.//SigningKey: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Production supplies this from user-secrets or the environment; a committed key would let anyone mint a session for any account.

Mail.//: Host/Port are supplied by the Aspire AppHost (Mail__Host, Mail__Port) pointing at the Mailpit container — ADR-0023.

Security.//TokenEncryptionKey: DEVELOPMENT ONLY (ADR-0061). Base64 AES-256 key that encrypts share tokens at rest. Production supplies this from the environment; there is deliberately no key in the base appsettings, so a prod boot without the secret fails closed rather than using a known key.

Security.//EmailHashKey: DEVELOPMENT ONLY (ADR-0062). Base64 key for the HMAC-SHA256 that reduces email addresses to a stored hash. Production supplies this from the environment; losing or changing it breaks decline-cooldown matching and invitation lookups.
